title: Getty enters a restructuring agreement to take the company private, with Getty family and Koch Equity committing to invest up to $533M to own 100% of Getty (Anhata Rooprai/Reuters)
summary: Anhata Rooprai / Reuters: Getty enters a restructuring agreement to take the company private, with Getty family and Koch Equity committing to invest up to $533M to own 100% of Getty — Getty Images (GETY.PK) said on Monday it had secured support from major creditors and investors for a comprehensive restructuring that will cut debt …
